summary: A combination antipsychotic used for schizophrenia and bipolar I disorder. Designed to maintain olanzapine’s efficacy while helping limit weight gain. Must NOT be used with opioids.
description: Lybalvi pairs olanzapine—a highly effective atypical antipsychotic—with samidorphan, an opioid receptor blocker intended to reduce olanzapine-related weight gain. It treats schizophrenia and manic or mixed episodes in bipolar I disorder, and can be continued for maintenance. Because samidorphan blocks opioid effects, Lybalvi cannot be taken with opioid pain medications and should not be started in anyone who is opioid dependent or in acute withdrawal. Like other antipsychotics, it increases mortality risk in older adults with dementia-related psychosis and is not approved for that use.
patient_summary: Lybalvi is used for schizophrenia and bipolar I disorder. It works like olanzapine but includes a component to help reduce weight gain. Many people notice calmer thinking and improved mood stability. Sleepiness, dizziness, and metabolic changes can occur, so weight and labs are checked routinely. Do not take opioid pain medicines while using Lybalvi.

primary.context: Provides antipsychotic benefit similar to olanzapine with lower rates of substantial weight gain.
Approved for acute manic or mixed episodes and for maintenance after stabilization.

secondary.context: Associated with less weight gain compared with olanzapine, though monitoring remains essential.

pharmacokinetics.absorption: Oral; food does not meaningfully affect exposure.
pharmacokinetics.metabolism: Olanzapine via UGT1A4, CYP1A2 (minor CYP2D6); samidorphan via CYP3A4 and other CYPs.
pharmacokinetics.excretion: Primarily urine and feces as drug plus metabolites.

sections.heading: What It’s Used For
sections.text: Lybalvi is for adults who need an antipsychotic with strong efficacy and want a lower chance of significant weight gain.
items: {link:condition:schizophrenia:Schizophrenia}: Helps reduce hallucinations, delusions, and disorganized thinking.
{link:condition:bipolar-i-disorder:Bipolar I Disorder}: Calms manic or mixed episodes and supports long-term stability.
off_label: Situations where olanzapine would be considered but metabolic risk is a barrier

sections.heading: What People Often Notice

Mood swings and agitation gradually settled.

sections.intro: Common experiences based on patient reports:

sections.heading: How Fast It Works
sections.text: Some calming may be noticed within days; full benefit often builds over weeks.
key_points: 1–2 weeks: Noticeable improvement in hallucinations or manic energy.
4–6 weeks: Full effect clearer; dose adjustments may help.
Ongoing: Weight and metabolic effects evolve over months.

sections.heading: Critical Safety Information
sections.highlight: Never use with opioids—could cause withdrawal or dangerous attempts to override the blockade.
sections.black_box: Increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis. Not approved for dementia-related psychosis.
other: Sedation and impaired alertness (caution with driving/machinery)
patient_counseling: Tell every clinician that you take Lybalvi (opioid blockers).
Avoid opioids and discuss all pain plans in advance.
Expect weight and lab monitoring over time.
Report severe sedation, rash, fever, or unusual movements.

sections.heading: Side Effects
sections.summary: Common: sleepiness, dizziness, metabolic changes, weight gain (less than standard olanzapine).

common.patient_note: Monitoring weight, diet, and activity helps.

sections.heading: Stopping Safely
sections.text: Antipsychotics should be tapered gradually when possible to reduce withdrawal or symptom rebound.
key_points: Avoid abrupt stopping unless medically necessary.
Discuss timing and monitoring plan with your prescriber.
Watch for return of mood or psychotic symptoms.

sections.heading: Dosing Information
sections.text: Typical adult doses are taken once daily. Doses are based on the olanzapine component and adjusted for response and tolerability.

adult.bipolar: Monotherapy usually starts around 10–15 mg olanzapine with samidorphan 10 mg once daily; may be combined with lithium or valproate.
adult.schizophrenia: Often starts around 5–10 mg olanzapine with samidorphan 10 mg once daily; gradual adjustments made as needed.

sections.simple_explanation: One tablet daily; dose increases happen slowly while monitoring sedation and metabolic effects.

sections.heading: Special Groups
sections.text: Use caution in older adults, hepatic impairment, or renal impairment. Avoid in opioid use or withdrawal.
sections.pregnancy: Limited data; discuss risks and benefits. Newborn may show withdrawal-like symptoms.
sections.lactation: Present in breast milk at low levels; monitor infant for sedation or feeding issues.
sections.geriatrics: Higher sensitivity to side effects; not approved for dementia-related psychosis.
sections.renal: Severe impairment may increase exposure; avoid end-stage until more data.

items: CBC if low baseline counts or symptoms

sections.heading: Available Formulations
sections.text: Fixed-dose tablets containing olanzapine and samidorphan.

sections.heading: Mechanism of Action
sections.text: Olanzapine blocks dopamine and serotonin receptors, improving psychosis and mood symptoms. Samidorphan blocks opioid receptors and is believed to limit olanzapine-associated weight gain.

sections.heading: Place in Treatment
sections.text: Useful when olanzapine is effective but metabolic risk is a concern. Requires planning around pain management due to opioid blockade.

faqs.a: Lybalvi treats schizophrenia and manic or mixed episodes of bipolar I disorder and can be continued for maintenance.

faqs.q: Why can’t I take opioids with Lybalvi?
faqs.a: Samidorphan blocks opioid receptors, which can cause withdrawal or dangerous overdose attempts if you try to overcome the blockade.
You might, but studies show less weight gain than with olanzapine alone. Regular monitoring helps.

faqs.q: How long until I feel better?
faqs.a: Some calming happens in days, but clearer improvement in psychosis or mania often takes several weeks.

faqs.q: Is Lybalvi safe for older adults with dementia?
faqs.a: No. Like other antipsychotics, it carries a higher mortality risk and is not approved for dementia-related psychosis.
